newsitems.title: Bethesda finally fix the Skyrim Special Edition on-screen keyboard crashing SteamOS / Steam Deck
newsitems.contents:
A new update from Bethesda has rolled out for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition, and much like with Fallout 4, they finally fixed an annoying bug.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2026/08/bethesda-finally-fix-the-skyrim-special-edition-on-screen-keyboard-crashing-steamos-steam-deck/

newsitems.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Anniversary Edition - Update 1.7.99 (Updated Aug 27)
newsitems.author: christian.vanhoose
newsitems.contents: [h3][b]Additional Hotfix — August 27[/b][/h3][p][b]Crashes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a crash when opening the on-screen keyboard and submitting text on the game main menu on PlayStation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when opening the map multiple times on Xbox.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Installing the game in certain regions no longer shows the 14 out of 15 GB Creations storage space is used on PlayStation.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Today's update to The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition increases console mod storage limits and brings more Creations improvements and fixes.[/p][h1]Added and Updated Features[/h1][h3][b]Game[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Increased mod storage to 15 GB for both PlayStation 5 and Xbox.[/p][/*][/list][quote][p][b]Due to differences in platform storage systems, PlayStation 4 Creation storage is changed in the following ways: [/b]Creations storage expanded to approximately 16 GB, but download size may not match space used because of technical details of the PlayStation 4 console hardware; This may cause download size vs. installed size discrepancies. Storage usage may appear larger than expected when managing Creations; Due to the storage system partitions, PS4 users may experience a practical limit on the number of large Creations installed at once.[/p][/quote][list][*][p]Added localized strings fixes for UI and platform terminology.[/p][/*][*][p]A Creation’s Details page now includes instructions on how to report abusive or problematic mods.[/p][/*][*][p]Added bundling of Creations in the Skyrim Creations Menu to bring it to parity with Fallout and Starfield.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed storefront UI to support Creations box art at 3640 x 900 and 900 x 506 to be consistent with Starfield and Fallout 4. Older image sizes will still be supported and do not require immediate resubmission.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support to sort Creation categories by "Most Popular".[/p][/*][*][p]Creations flagged as WIP can now be viewed when bookmarked.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Creation Kit[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added Localization export support.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated "Search and Replace" to align with Starfield, adding buttons for "Select Form in Object Window" and "Open Form Editor".[/p][/*][*][p]Creation Kit will now allow multiple master loads by default. This can be configured as normal.[/p][/*][*][p]Skyrim Creations released through the Verified Creators program will have the option to be Achievement-Friendly (Xbox) and Trophy-Friendly (PlayStation). This means that certain Creations will no longer block achievements, but it requires starting a new game for this functionality to work on updated Creations.[/p][/*][*][p]Bink files can now be added to Creation uploads via an Extra Files browser.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanding beyond scripts, archives are now supported on PlayStation. New file types are available (.nif, .dds, .bink, .wav, and .fuz (with embedded .wav)) for PlayStation Creations.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Crashes[/b][/h1][h3][b]Game[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a crash when the player opens the Virtual Keyboard on a Steam Deck device.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when the player ‘selects’ an empty search result in the Creations menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when the player transforms into a new race.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Creation Kit[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a crash when the player closes the dialogue for a Sound Descriptor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when analyzing loot in a new encounter zone.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when clicking the Make Use Info button on some menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that can occur when reloading a mod without an associated Masterfile.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1][h3][b]Game[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Free Creations from Verified Creators now correctly appear in the Verified Creators category within the store.[/p][/*][*][p]Exiting out of Search when viewing a specific Creation now properly returns the player to the Details page of that Creation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where installed Creations would sometimes display the incorrect version number while on the pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Creations titles should now display with fewer misformatted characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where the Creations store would not always update visual pricing when Creations were placed on sale when a player had not changed menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where Anniversary Edition Creations failed to auto-download on PlayStation 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Search strings will no longer clip through text when searching for Creations,[/p][/*][*][p]The Verified Creator category should now correctly sort by latest and not alphabetical order.[/p][/*][*][p]Enabling an item in Load Order should now more consistently stick when selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Deleting all Creations now only clears mods downloaded from the Store and not those loaded via other means.[/p][/*][*][p]Uploading or restoring a Load Order containing a mod or Creation no longer available on the Marketplace should no longer fail.[/p][/*][*][p]Uploading or restoring a Load Order containing many mods should no longer fail.[/p][/*][*][p]The Creations store should now load more efficiently.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Creation Kit[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Creation Kit now forces consistent capitalization of platform-specific .bsa binaries to avoid runtime errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Archiving new forms in a plugin which relies on pre-existing assets will no longer cause the pre-existing form to duplicate within the plugin.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Creation submission can improperly tag a file as a Masterfile causing infinite data reload.[/p][/*][*][p]Cell forms should now populate correctly across all tabs when accessed via the Cell View window.[/p][/*][*][p]Altered forms will no longer count as new forms when creating a plugin.[/p][/*][*][p]Using the Create Archives or Upload process should more consistently apply correct compression to meshes/miscellaneous archives.[/p][/*][*][p]Browsing ids in the World Spaces window should no longer alter the forms.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved error message pop-up when attempting to open the Creation Kit while [url="https://Bethesda.net"]Bethesda.net[/url] services were offline.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Updated the game credits.[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: New realms, new companions, and new powers, all in these Skyrim Creations.
newsitems.author: Jesscapade
newsitems.contents: [h1][b]Heart of the Mountain[/b][/h1][h3][i]By DarthVitrial[/i][/h3][previewyoutube="LNr8HGZPGVA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/e4ff5b06ed0e06507526eecdc4712001d2d96eca.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/a3a07b9e558ee2761285575b0ea2c103e6982837.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/2b68f8e54d272bef040d41057dca2883973a706f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/4261cfb823d8b7a4b63a0542a92829a1ea5d85d0.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/0e5f8707-4376-4dd7-a4b0-0d5f311829d0/Heart_of_the_Mountain"]Explore the mysteries of the Void in a large new land[/url] with professionally voiced characters, exciting new music, and new art for a special follower, land, gear, and foes![/p][p]Venture into the Old Lands, a vast new world that hosts multiple new biomes, including a scorching desert, mist-shrouded swamp, and a haunted forest, in this story-focused, fully-voiced creation! Explore over 40 new full-size dungeons, including Ayleid Ruins, dro-m’Athra temples, Argonian xanmeers, and more![/p][p align="start"]Team up with Audrey, a mysterious living doll, as you unravel the mysteries of the Void and learn the truth of the Old Lands. Take on almost 70 unique quests and 20 Radiant quests as you explore the Old Lands, and gain new weapons and gear sets, including the new Voskrona armor! In this new land, you will encounter new enemies and summonable creatures from the depths of the Void, such as Harrowing Reapers and Voidmothers, ancient Argonian foes such as Voriplasms and Voskrona, and many more...[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Sigil of the Fallen[/b][/h1][h3][i]By Kinggath Creations[/i][/h3][previewyoutube="V1jKQHWGE-Y;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/fe77dc9e40072ce89492d0d6ff08d4864c71fbb3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/9536f99517ce8d287158cdbaa631260b851c4e83.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/6928d526f60d38f82b445997f7de13aafe1e2c4a.png"][/img][/p][p]Rumors of strange sightings northeast of Markarth have reached your ears, calling you to the Sigil Geode -- where through fate or folly, spirits will be unleashed across Skyrim, leaving you to return them and [url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/1e80e12f-cba3-433b-aded-29bb846a1b29/Sigil_of_the_Fallen"]uncover the mystery of the Soul Sanctum[/url].[/p][list][*][p]Mystery of the Soul Sanctum - Begin a new questline revealing the fate of three powerful heroes, and a girl with an unfortunate gift. Featuring multiple huge dungeons with challenging encounters, puzzles, secrets, and boss fights.[/p][/*][*][p align="start"]4-in-1 Upgradeable Spirit Companion - A ghost follower that can channel the form, abilities, memories, and voice of powerful heroes. Shift her between classes on demand and unlock new powers and abilities over time.[/p][/*][*][p align="start"]3 Powerful New Relics - A shield with a massive slam ability, a mace that can close the distance, and a staff that can summon explosive orbs. Each of these items comes with unique functionality and will be upgraded as you go deeper into their former owner's stories.[/p][/*][*][p align="start"]Hunt Spirits - Spirits unleashed on Skyrim possess items, furniture, doors, and even enemies. Seek them out to gain the material needed to upgrade your companion, or take jobs from the Priests of Arkay to clear hauntings throughout Skyrim.[/p][/*][*][p align="start"]As you engage more with the mechanics and story - additional depth, options, and rewards will be revealed. All of the content is professionally voice-acted and is designed to work seamlessly with the base game, DLCs, and many other community mods![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]A Secret Beneath the Ice[/b][/h1][h3][i]By Tinuvia[/i][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/19483a9857afdb1bb9bc1434457536295962cda2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/cd85a26906bbdf18c80544752d6ac86452d0a4c7.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/4e998efe69ac2a551fc7fc762cec8c0d0d8adc6f.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/95dd43e1-a627-4a7c-89ff-aeb85d5fb142/A_Secret_Beneath_the_Ice"]Explore three new medium sized icy dungeons[/url] to locate missing College students. Fight unique bosses, retrieve ancient tomes, loot unique treasure, 5 custom mage robes and 3 spells.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Honey-Licker: An Argonian Beeko[/b][/h1][h3][i]By Dexco-Productions[/i][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/876dc7073c2467cdcaa6bf7ad98fcb0603ef8bd5.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/c060cc3632ab78a5bb1889601ef18d5717dac8eb.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/133572d1-5410-4ffe-a51e-9e632b0ad88c/Honey_Licker__An_Argonian_Beeko"]Meet Honey-Licker[/url]! A down on her luck saxhleel, with a love (if a little too much) for mead and fighting kuudas. Having traveled all the way from the Black Marsh to Skyrim on a journey of self discovery, Honey-Licker tries to see the bright side of life, even though she feels the constant pull of despair. With a more expressionless face than most argonian she feels the need to say how she feels, rather than letting her body language speak for her. See how the mindset of her saxhleel culture pairs with the cold north that is Skyrim, her fear of dwemer ruins, or her dismissive attitude toward breton culture. Give her a drink and see her fight enemies drunk![/p][p][/p][h1][b]NIGHTBLADE - Shadow Magic Unleashed[/b][/h1][h3][i]By MysticMadman[/i] [/h3][previewyoutube="QXIcUK9cvrQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Embark deep into the shadows and [url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/68c9d574-686c-4be2-b879-94639c796781/NIGHTBLADE___Shadow_Magic_Unleashed"]walk the path of the Nightblade[/url]. Claim ancient wisdom from the notorious Scarlet Star-Oak. Purchase esoteric tomes and ancient Nightblade relics, and master the mysterious arts of Shadow and Poison magic. Featuring brand-new teleportation mechanics! Seek out Scarlet Star-Oak in Boulderfall Cave, which now functions as a player home, southwest of Shor's Stone.[/p][p]This mod features 20 new spells, new weapon and armor enchantments, new food, a new player home, as well as a new follower descending from an ancient bloodline of Nightblades.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]TEMPLAR - Holy Magic Reborn[/b][/h1][h3][i]By MysticMadman[/i][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/d3135d9e74302d53eebca18d780394678f4164e2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/0c40ab6f866e18173543883e2b9ac5bbe2a00f7f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/996df666b6fcbba4e1a2f77af568d6cc607bc22f.png"][/img][/p][p]Embrace the Gods and [url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/5c3ab666-b6fc-46b5-b7aa-b558c2eac39a/TEMPLAR___Holy_Magic_Reborn"]walk the path of the Iron Templars[/url]. Claim sacred relics, master sacred Restoration magic, and uncover holy ancient rites. Featuring brand-new prayer mechanics. Seek out Thomeus Krucius in the Temple of the Divines in Solitude to unlock lost Templar knowledge, powerful Aedra blessed spells, and divine abilities that heal allies, smite the undead, and bring holy judgment upon your foes.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Cadwallon Estate[/b][/h1][h3][i]By Gemini_Void[/i][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/b64a16335cf3f486822ed0ca7d0dc6178779e9c0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/f07435079bf90b4267231809eb7fa7b2531d5960.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/04eb8dd0aa06dcb302cacf5df2c20bbe8b4b195a.png"][/img][/p][p]Introducing a brand [url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/d729bc86-0778-4841-9628-116327885694/Cadwallon_Estate"]new moderate sized player home[/url] just down the Darkwater River from Ivarstead, overlooking Eastmarch Hold from beneath the Throat of the World.[/p][p]Cadwallon Estate features a luxurious mansion, situated on the cliffs overlooking Eastmarch hold near Darkwater River. From the balcony one can enjoy a pleasant view of the Sulfur Pools in Eastmarch. The home is marked on your map by default at the start of your game. This home does not have a quest to obtain it, instead you may interact with the For Sale sign just outside the gate. When you do, you'll be prompted to purchase the home for 15,000 septims. Once you have purchased it, you will receive the key and may freely enter the home.[/p]

newsitems.title: This new Skyrim mod is unashamedly vibe-coded, but it lets you swing NPCs into each other with ragdoll physics, so we all win
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
If there's one thing I can't get enough of, it's ragdoll physics in video games. While their inclusion can ruin the mood of some of the best RPGs by pinging people (and players) around like they're made of jelly, there's just something hilarious about them. Like puppets. And if this Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim: Special Edition mod is half as good as it looks, I worry for the guards always chasing me out of Makarth. Seriously, I can't remember what I did there years ago, but they've never let me live it down.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: This new Skyrim mod is unashamedly vibe-coded, but it lets you swing NPCs into each other with ragdoll physics, so we all win

newsitems.title: This Skyrim mod that makes NPCs AI chatterboxes just got a massive overhaul
newsitems.author: Rich Stanton
newsitems.contents: Skyrim's got a lot of NPCs. Thing is, most of 'em are dolts. They don't have any kind of distinct personality or routine, and sometimes do the dumbest stuff imaginable. I'll never forget the time a dragon flew down to attack me near a settlement, destroying some fencing in the process, and the entire town swivelled before charging towards me, daggers drawn, completely ignoring the massive dragon in their midst that had actually caused the damage... Read more.

newsitems.title: Make Skyrim's weather feel more impactful with this particle mod
newsitems.author: Jody Macgregor
newsitems.contents: I loved The Witcher 3's wobbly bushes. In the original version of The Witcher 3 they used to sway like they were singing Auld Lang Syne on New Year's Eve, and it really helped bring Velen to life. Particle Wind, a mod by RavenKZP, does the same for Skyrim... Read more.

newsitems.title: Popular Skyrim mod returns after 9 years with a major update and a full source code release to keep it relevant 'for many years to come'
newsitems.author: Tyler Colp
newsitems.contents: Someone check on the Skyrim Nexus Mods, users because one of the most popular mods has reappeared with a new update after nine years... Read more.

newsitems.title: Adventure awaits in these Skyrim Creations!
newsitems.author: Jesscapade
newsitems.contents: [h1][b]Legacy of Orsinium[/b][/h1][p]By Veelpoot[/p][previewyoutube="ysP6yaiMm_o;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/cea9b78f3069f92b531fec580158d1f1336afa71.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/eb15fc2aa8e6692d488a83445938ecc51b71dfbe.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/4b145c4b6947eee807effbf2a840c442ba12fdd3.png"][/img][/p][p]New adventures await from the creators of Lordbound! Prove your worth to the Agra Crun, as the might of Orsinium descends upon a humble stronghold. Travel through the expanded mines of Mor Khazgur, inspired by the events in The Elder Scrolls Online and uncover the secrets of a long-forgotten Orcish tomb.[/p][list][*][p][url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/6fd8aec6-9d25-4532-b416-a9a8db6a1ed7/Legacy_of_Orsinium"]Legacy of Orsinium[/url]: A new professionally-voiced storyline with multiple endings for the Orc stronghold of Mor Khazgur![/p][/*][*][p]Orc Strongholds Quests: new side quests for all Orc strongholds: Narzulbur, Dushnikh Yal and even Largashbur![/p][/*][*][p]Armors & Artifacts: unique items & quest rewards inspired by the Orsinium DLC from The Elder Scrolls Online.[/p][/*][*][p]Epic Dungeons: new dungeons made by veteran modder RoKMod, best known for his dungeons in Lordbound and Children of Ug-Qualtoth.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Defenders of Hla’ruhn[/b][/h1][p]By MysticMadman[/p][previewyoutube="gsrrQ9W45JM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/11a1660c69b656349c0e6375ecc6b2ccbac6edb4.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/994882f9329a5c5a93d5d884563f5470687ddd35.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/67af25652397c6b1f396ecb6ef687c5881287a81.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/3c5c07ca-de6b-4833-ab2d-0a9ffd38ca83/Defenders_of_Hla_ruhn"]Seek out and recruit Nammu-ko[/url], an honorable Khajiit mercenary currently lodging at the Bannered Mare. She and many other Defenders of Hla’ruhn - a bustling trading town in the Sea of Ghosts - have journeyed to Skyrim in hopes of aiding in the fight against the dragon menace. Claim five glorious new sets of armor of Hlaalu craftsmanship, and uncover Nammu-ko’s hidden past![/p][list][*][p]Five beautifully crafted armor sets of traditional Hlaalu design.[/p][/*][*][p]A fully voiced Follower, Nammu-ko, featuring an emotional character arc.[/p][/*][*][p]Fourteen newly added Defenders of Hla'ruhn, hand-placed throughout Skyrim.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Aetherspire Castle[/b][/h1][p]By PrincessMely[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/f47c9df7af2fc425c84826d5ca3356c30eb3ac4b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/e058194ec796f83315ee608323fe815a9fc82552.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/46e80d28e094f0d4e445f0f12f0def6684633756.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/724ebef7eb4ea2d7656723a0163031f6654fbdf0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/4dee0d8d15fb1af9719baa2ec64a7c886684d441.png"][/img][/p][p]Journey on a quest to explore [url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/56d14a37-39ab-4b53-b42a-7e393462dd2c/Aetherspire_Castle"]the mysterious castle[/url] that has suddenly appeared in the sea of ghosts, in Skyrim’s far north. Meet new characters, discover hidden treasures, and claim Aetherspire Castle as your own, in this new mystical experience.[/p][p]Aetherspire is a full-fledged player home complete with an alchemy garden, throne room, training rooms, dining room, blacksmiths, library, kitchen, dressing hall, bathhouse, and a master bedroom. Aetherspire also features portals to every major settlement, and many secret items to be found.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Thief Hideouts[/b][/h1][p]By: TheRealElianora[/p][previewyoutube="Gzx8vbaYpc4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/132c977b6f245b561cd523212d3a3e09ec86ce3d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/ffa8a4cb78a66d6d504627d6c283ea8efbfd3f6c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/4ccb3110a47a8fb4659533dde7f79a2e36422d13.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/adec776c-9f0a-4c0b-8a57-14da3bde0b7c/Thief_Hideouts"]A small hideout in every major city[/url] (Riften, Solitude, Whiterun, Windhelm and Markarth) for your thief character. They can be accessed through wells in the cities.[/p][list][*][p]STATIC CLUTTER - Lydia can't knock over my beautiful decorations and an accidental Fis Roh Dah [/p][/*][*][p] Unmarked quest to get a key to the homes [/p][/*][*][p]Teleport markers in each home to quickly travel between different major city entrances (Markarth, Riften, Solitude, Whiterun, Windhelm) [/p][/*][*][p]A universal "thieves cache" that is accessible from every hideout so you can store all your sellable thief gains into one chest, accessible in every home! [/p][/*][*][p]The usual benefits of well-rested, follower-friendly, crafting stations, totally respawn-safe containers etc.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]The Starmade Blade[/b][/h1][p]By: TheLootist[/p][previewyoutube="_d31GKQTjJc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/5ac8b9927e1874565ca66bd5771f043873764d5a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/4eee961e3c7998fdcd65080e7be86fc14cb767b9.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/c310230fbc84d9d0a3b8d676ae67ae94f1b229af.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/053e29f5e7ce0a1bf6c4a1ffff9cfd3ac0522645.png"][/img][/p][p]Hired by the owner of Ironsong Mine, you and a team of three new characters explore the halls of Oioran, an Ayleid ruin hidden beneath the soil and stone of The Rift. Many secrets are scattered throughout the halls of Oioran. Accompanied by the mine owner, his bodyguard and their hired researcher from Cyrodiil, will you be able to find them all? Or will you succumb to the many dangers that await you? Here, you will find a new powerful sword, [url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/b948564a-7015-4ac3-a561-6ec6afe31be3/The_Starmade_Blade___Customizable_Sword_and_Quest"]The Star-Made Blade[/url].[/p][p] [/p][p align="start"]Exploring this Oioran, the Ayleid Ruin, you will be given the chance to uncover its secrets. Why are these Ayleids in Skyrim? New enemies that lay waiting in its crumbling halls? And what treasures will you find along the way?[/p][list][*][p]Weapon: The Star-Made Blade, a customizable sword which you can tune to any star sign. Changing the Star sign of sword gives you a unique buff while equipped and a appearance, changing the colour of the blade and the gem in its hilt. Power attacks release a unique constellation projectile at you enemies dealing great damage. [/p][/*][*][p]Dungeon: a large new Ayleid dungeon, containing multiple highly detailed areas with lots of opportunities to explore. [/p][/*][*][p]Quest: A detailed quest with choices, consequences and lots of reactive dialogue from new characters as you explore the ruins. [/p][/*][*][p]Optional Objective: Contains an optional objective where you will have to explore extra carefully to uncover the secrets and history of the Ayleid’s who once lived here. To accept this, make sure to Ask Calindil about what the Ayleid tablets say. [/p][/*][*][p]New Enemies: Ayleid Skeletons clad in Elven armor wait within the depths of the ruins, as well as new unheard-of foes deeper into the ruins. [/p][/*][*][p] 8 New Summon Spells: 8 new spells that can be found throughout the dungeon allowing you to summon the new enemies added into this Creation. Make sure you explore fully to find them.  [/p][/*][*][p]Boss Fight: A tough new boss fight with new custom mechanics[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Well, someone made an Ulfric Stormcloak Big Naturals mod
newsitems.author: Jody Macgregor
newsitems.contents: First, the Baldur's Gate 3 modding community gave Elminster Big Naturals, and then everyone's favorite dignified corpse Withers too. The Skyrim modding community, not one to be left behind, has finally followed suit... Read more.

newsitems.title: I thought I was finally free from stealth-focused Skyrim builds, then someone modded in the ability to hide in bushes
newsitems.author: Jody Macgregor
newsitems.contents: It's me, the player who starts Skyrim over and over with different mod loadouts and yet, nine times out of 10, ends up crouching with a bow shooting draugr in slow motion. Every now and then I push myself into another playstyle—like two-handed melee barbarian or summon-focused wizard—but drift back to my old favorite. I haven't installed the mod that just kills you if you play Stealth Archer again, but I am absolutely part of the reason that mod exists... Read more.

newsitems.title: I didn't even know I was bothered by how bad Skyrim's NPCs look during the split second they're opening doors, and now a modder's pointed it out the mod to fix it has become essential
newsitems.author: Jody Macgregor
newsitems.contents: The way NPCs open doors in Skyrim has always been a bit silly. When they're crossing load screens they can't open them all the way—because then the other side would have to be rendered—and so they pop doors open a crack revealing a sliver of darkness, then fade out of existence like the guy in that one meme... Read more.

newsitems.title: Skyrim mod The Rot Below promises a '3–6 hour dungeon experience' and is fully voice-acted
newsitems.author: Jody Macgregor
newsitems.contents: Sometimes in Skyrim you wander into a hole in the ground, fight some draugr, defeat a dragon priest, collect a shout, and leave via an exit that conveniently loops you back to where you came in. Sometimes you end up in a gloaming fungal underworld and only emerge hours later barely remembering what the surface looks like. If you'd like more of the latter experience, The Rot Below is probably the mod for you... Read more.

newsitems.title: Сценарист Bethesda объяснил, почему создавать сюжеты для Fallout сложнее, чем для The Elder Scrolls
newsitems.author: Илья Корпылёв
newsitems.contents: Дизайн-директор Bethesda Game Studios Эмиль Пальяруло сравнил в интервью GamesRadar+ подходы к созданию сценариев для игр двух главных франшиз компании — The Elder Scrolls и Fallout. Разработчик отметил, что прописывать историю в научно-фантастическом сеттинге гораздо труднее, чем в фэнтезийном.

newsitems.title: "Уникальная, потрясающая, произведение искусства": Создатель Starfield Тодд Говард определил лучшую игру 2025 года
newsitems.author: Павел Вескер
newsitems.contents: Руководитель Bethesda Game Studios Тодд Говард оcтался под большим впечатлением от нашумевшей пошаговой ролевой игры Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 (наш обзор). В беседе с журналистами Eurogamer ведущий продюсер The Elder Scrolls и Fallout назвал дебютный проект французской студии Sandfall Interactive лучшим в 2025 году.

newsitems.title: Find your next Skyrim adventure in these mini DLC-sized Creations!
newsitems.author: Jesscapade
newsitems.contents: [h2][b]Coven of Crones [/b][/h2][p]by Hightale[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="1KvwxJEgsxo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/ccbe2c79-9749-41b1-97e0-1097e087d593/Coven_of_Crones"]Coven of Crones[/url] is an exciting new land and quest creation, which explores a secretive plot orchestrated by Anise and her coven of Hags, who have settled in a mysterious land once home to druids, but now a cesspool of lost souls doomed to be fodder to the Crones' wicked scheme.[/p][p] [/p][p align="start"]Explore The Blighted Marsh, a Solstheim-sized island encased by raging storms in the Sea of Ghosts. and fight to unravel Anise's plans. The Marsh is home to new custom creatures to slay, professional grade voice acted quests to complete, dungeons to explore, and many additions to aid you in your future adventures.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Laylana: a companion creation[/b][/h2][p]By TheOscar0[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="bnY4FM2PffE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/4f5ca59a-4842-484b-9ecb-cdcb8ee937e9/Laylana___A_Companion_Creation"]Laylana is a fully voiced companion creation[/url]. After recently leaving her estate in the Imperial Province for the first time, Laylana wishes to see the wonders of Skyrim. But she does not want to do so alone. Take Laylana with you as your companion, travel across Skyrim and undertake quests together.[/p][p] [/p][p align="start"]This follower creation includes:[/p][p align="start"]• Over 1300 lines of fully voiced professional dialogue, including: in depth character story, quest and location commentary, extensive combat lines, and more witty remarks than you'll know what to do with![/p][p align="start"]• An affinity system. Laylana's relationship with you will change depending on how you treat her and the actions you take. Be kind to her and she will think of you as a great friend. Treat her poorly, and she may just leave you altogether.[/p][p align="start"]• The option to romance her. Travel with her for some time, treat her well, say the right things, and she may be open to more than just a friendship.[/p][p align="start"]• A combat capable companion. Laylana is a strong mage proficient with many spells that will level alongside you.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]A Tale of Blood and Snow[/b][/h1][p]By DarthVitrial[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/a6cce24e88b8957b33ee689d7c2c69e21e57ade4.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/eea15078d0633706ec8bc5f65f1a6d06fdffab84.png"][/img][/p][p]Decide the future of Skyrim’s vampires in this [url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/4e3bf6f3-8632-4f5d-8094-fbb245b3d22a/A_Tale_of_Blood_and_Snow"]DLC-sized story Creation[/url]! Lead the Quarra or Cronvangr clans to victory over their rivals as a vampire or stay mortal and help the Vigilants of Stendarr purge Skyrim of both clans![/p][p]For millennia, the vampire clans of the Old Holds have been led by the venerable Cronvangr Clan. But as the Fourth Era enters its third century, the Cronvangr find themselves challenged by the Quarra Clan of Morrowind, who seek to establish themselves as the new power in Skyrim. Now, the conflict between the two clans has spread to engulf all of Skyrim, and it will come down to a single newcomer to decide the fate of Skyrim’s vampires: You. Will you join the Cronvangr? The Quarra? Or will you help the Vigilants of Stendarr see both clans destroyed?[/p][p align="start"]This DLC-sized Creation adds a fully-voiced storyline with over 3000 lines of dialogue, 10 new dungeons, dozens of new quests, new armor and jewelry, new weapons, and exciting new magical effects in the form of never-before-seen spells, perks, and item enchantments that will change how you play all of Skyrim![/p][p align="start"]Pick your allegiance and guide your chosen faction to victory! The main quest can be started by sleeping after becoming a vampire (all routes) or speaking to Bazur gro-Shagk at Stendarr’s Beacon once the Hall of the Vigilant is destroyed (Vigilants only).[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Echoes of the Vale[/b][/h1][p]By EasierRider[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/3aedc9c92487c06dc6760c34ed149b0e8758aa6b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/4d0a674069d540c1edfe72dc562417c40b3b1103.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/f5aa690a5565ba40df0eeca8b224109e003b680b.png"][/img][url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/8cd2c3c4-5464-4d1b-bdc2-77560a3dc296/Echoes_of_the_Vale"]This Creation nearly doubles the size of the Forgotten Vale[/url] by adding new dungeons and landscapes that are lore-friendly and visually similar to the base game. Most importantly, it elevates the Forgotten Vale from a linear, quest-based experience into a larger world all its own. A new player home, Initiate’s Rest, serves as a base camp from which you can discover the wonders of this lost world. By liberating the Forgotten Vale from the Dawnguard questline, this Creation aims to make it a place that the player can enter, and return to, when and how they choose. In order to maximize compatibility and immersion, this Creation does not alter existing quests, character, and locations of the Forgotten Vale.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Bards College Expansion[/b][/h1][p]By Kinggath_Creations[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="CoTp89sqeSg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The Archbard, Sledrig, and an entourage of teachers and students have returned to Skyrim and are ready to impart their knowledge.[/p][list][*][p align="start"]5th Major Faction Storyline - [url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/d9436fab-12d5-4bcf-a8a1-c359d6a200ea/Bards_College_Expansion"]Bards College[/url] storyline has been greatly expanded to match the scale and intrigue of the other faction questlines in Skyrim.[/p][/*][*][p align="start"]Play Music - Play instruments on the move and use them to earn gold playing for an audience, or to inspire your allies in combat.[/p][/*][*][p align="start"]Expanded Shout System - In addition to new Shouts, Shouts can be upgraded by capturing them in Resonant Crystals, and a new weapon type allows for stringing together multiple Shouts into a Chant.[/p][/*][*][p align="start"]Ballads of Your Accomplishments - Spread your reputation throughout the province with song. After completing certain major questlines in Skyrim, work with Olvus to craft a song about your exploits and hear them sung in the town squares of major cities.[/p][/*][*][p align="start"]Duel With Your Wits - Learn insults and retorts to battle other Bards in games of wordplay that can earn you coin and prestige.[/p][/*][*][p align="start"]Become an Emissary - Use your words to inspire, coerce, and intimidate people into doing your bidding, and help the Bards College become a political force.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]As you engage more with the mechanics and story - additional depth, options, and rewards will be revealed.[/p][p align="start"]All of the content is professionally voice-acted and is designed to work seamlessly with the base game, DLCs, and many other community mods![/p][p][/p][h1][b]Truth in Legends[/b][/h1][p]By Shoeburglar[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="IUbDxbsQ1XI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/f92b4abcc046242c72a0e5e435562a90d3cb4d0d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25333721/265284aa893513a49012f9b8dcd026fe8ee85aa0.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/e4dd9784-2dd5-41c1-8007-53248cd09dcd/Truth_in_Legends"]Become the God of Thunder[/url]. Includes a Mjolnir inspired hammer and Norse Shield Svalinn with 11 new perks, animations and spells along with Hover Mode, a mechanic that allows the player to skirt along the ground like a god. The hammer can be obtained upon defeating The Stormherald in a legendary boss fight the player must overcome at the end of a new large-sized dungeon.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: Ведущий дизайнер The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim объяснил, почему играм Bethesda можно простить обилие багов
newsitems.author: Stewenpl
newsitems.contents: Ведущий дизайнер The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Брюс Несмит признал, что многие игры Bethesda получаются на релизе менее отполированными, чем хотелось бы. Однако на это, по его мнению, можно закрыть глаза.

newsitems.title: See the remade version of Oblivion's tutorial dungeon in the first 15 minutes of a Skyblivion playthrough
newsitems.author: Jody Macgregor
newsitems.contents: Every year at Creation Mod Con, a showcase for the Skyrim modding community, the Skyblivion team gets to show off their remake of Oblivion in the Skyrim engine. This year it's a real treat: the tutorial dungeon that takes you from an insulting dark elf, through your meeting with Emperor Sir Patrick Stewart, battles with the cultists of the Mythic Dawn, into the sewers, and then out into the bright light of day... Read more.

newsitems.title: Skyblivion only has one region of the map left to finish: 'We are nearly ready to release an entirely remastered Elder Scrolls game'
newsitems.author: Jody Macgregor
newsitems.contents: The TESRenewal modding group has been working on Skyblivion, a remastered version of Oblivion playable in Skyrim Special Edition, since 2018 "in earnest" though the project "officially started over 11 years ago," as the latest progress video explains. Said video also mentions how close to completion Skyblivion is, fast approaching its scheduled 2025 release. "We are nearly ready to release an entirely remastered Elder Scrolls game," the team says... Read more.

newsitems.title: Here's a mod that gives Skyrim Special Edition its own Witcher-style bestiary
newsitems.author: Jody Macgregor
newsitems.contents: Some mods fill obvious gaps. Others, you don't know you need until you discover they exist. For instance, I had no idea I needed a mod that gave me a randomized psychedelic experience every time I drank skooma until I learned it existed, and now it's an essential part of every playthrough... Read more.
